name: Security Group Ingress Opened to Internet
description: An attacker with ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress adds an ingress rule that allows traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 (any IPv4 address). This can expose SSH, RDP, databases, or application ports to the internet and enable follow-on access to instances that use the security group. Required permission is ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress.
